description:
**Severity: high · Dimension: unsafe-isolation** (report finding #2)

Four `pub unsafe fn` in `crates/gf2-kernels-simd/src/x86/fp_generic.rs` (lines 155, 229, 266, 296: `fp_montgomery_mul4`, `fp_montgomery_batch_mul`, `fp_montgomery_batch_add`, `fp_montgomery_batch_sub`) have no `# Safety` doc section and no `// SAFETY:` comments before their `get_unchecked` / raw-pointer dereferences. A file-level (and ~14 submodule) `#![allow(clippy::missing_safety_doc)]` silences Clippy enforcement, papering over the root cause.

Project invariant: all `unsafe` lives in the kernel crates AND every `pub unsafe fn` carries a `// SAFETY:` comment (AGENTS.md invariant #3).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: All four functions gain a `# Safety` doc section stating AVX2-availability and input-validity preconditions.
- [hard] REQ-02: A `// SAFETY:` comment precedes each unsafe operation site (get_unchecked / raw-pointer deref) in the four functions.
- [hard] REQ-03: The `#![allow(clippy::missing_safety_doc)]` is removed from `lib.rs` and from the submodule files where it appears; clippy passes with `-D warnings` afterwards (add per-fn docs as needed so the allow is unnecessary).
- [hard] REQ-04: Full `cargo nextest --profile ci`, clippy, and fmt pass.
title: Document safety contracts for fp_generic unsafe kernels
